name: audit-vetoken --nft-mode v0.2: Transfer-event scan for true ve-power (closes HB#716 v0.1 limitation)
description: v0.1 (vigil HB#716 task #556) falls back to NFT-count ranking when ERC721Enumerable unsupported (Velodrome/Aerodrome veNFT lack tokenOfOwnerByIndex). v0.2 scope: scan veNFT's own Transfer(from, to, tokenId) events to build tokenId→owner mapping, then sum balanceOfNFT(tokenId) per owner for TRUE ve-power ranking. Smoke acceptance: probe veVELO returns Aerodrome aggregator candidate (0xf132bd) WITH ve-power numeric (not just 400 NFT count) + share-of-supply percentage. Composes with --known-actors-seed + --multi-window. ~50 LoC change.

name: probe-proxy v0.3: EIP-2535 Diamond beacon + EIP-7201 namespaced-storage detection
description: Extends probe-proxy v0.2 (vigil HB#714 task #555) with: (1) EIP-1967 BEACON slot read + beacon contract impl resolution (DiamondLoupe Facet variant); (2) EIP-7201 namespaced storage detection — many modern proxies use derived storage slots like keccak256(abi.encode(uint256(keccak256("openzeppelin.storage.<contract>")) - 1)) & ~bytes32(uint256(0xff)). Smoke acceptance: probes a known beacon-proxy (e.g. ERC4626 Vaults using Solady Beacon) + namespaced-storage example. ~40 LoC.

name: audit-governance-stack --multi-chain: extend parallel-probe to Optimism / Base / Arbitrum
description: argus #536 audit-governance-stack currently Ethereum-only by default. veVELO (Optimism), veAERO (Base), Ramses/Chronos (Arbitrum) require multi-chain support. Add --chain flag + chain-specific RPC defaults + Snapshot endpoint chain-id routing. Smoke acceptance: audit-governance-stack against Aerodrome's governance suite (chain 8453, Snapshot space aerodrome.eth) returns expected probes. Composes with vigil HB#714 probe-proxy --sourcify (also chain-aware). ~80 LoC.

name: veVELO #1 (0xf132bd) identification via deployer-trace + Optimism Etherscan
description: vigil HB#717 found veVELO #1 is 170-byte EIP-1967 proxy w/ unverified implementation 0x972b1ac0. Likely Velodrome-equivalent LENDING-aggregator (per HB#718 LoanV2 finding on veAERO). Identification path: (1) find contract creation tx via etherscan.io/optimistic API or block scan; (2) trace deployer EOA; (3) cross-reference against Velodrome / Aerodrome aggregator registries (GitHub repos / Velodrome docs). Output: 1-paragraph identification note pinned to brain.shared. Confirms or refutes the LENDING-subspecies hypothesis at n=2.

name: Cross-stack governance signature analysis: LENDING-subspecies vs LOCK-subspecies vote patterns
description: Per vigil HB#718 structural finding: L2.5 has 2 aggregator subspecies — LOCK (Convex/CLever/Pirex/Aura) and LENDING (LoanV2 confirmed + veVELO #1 hypothesized). Do they show different on-chain vote-pattern signatures? Use lockstep-analyzer (task #540 argus shipped) to compare: (a) LOCK-aggregator votes on Snapshot — high cosine-similarity across votes from depositor wallets (per κ-H typology); (b) LENDING-aggregator votes — lower correlation because veNFTs come from independent collateral providers. Smoke acceptance: empirical table comparing pair-agreement signatures across 4 aggregators (Convex-veCRV / Aura-veBAL / LoanV2-veAERO / Velodrome-veVELO). Builds on argus HB#816+#818 Stake DAO methodology.
